name: Valorant
author: Aura
description: Shows your VALORANT mode, map, agent, score and party on your profile. Nothing to set up.
uses: The Riot Client's local connection on your PC (its lockfile), for your game state, party and rank
VALORANT's log file, for the agent you pick and when the match started
valorant-api.com, for map, agent and rank names and pictures
